unternehmen.label: Unternehmen
unternehmen.description:
Arbitrary number of referenced LivingApp records from the target lookup app 'Unternehmen' with the id `6a79d8abade761cee4db4fd8`.

The field value will be a list of valid record URLs in the form `https://test.living-apps.de/rest/apps/6a79d8abade761cee4db4fd8/records/<record-id>`.

When writing, either pass record URLs through exactly as this API returned them, or send the portable relative form `/apps/6a79d8abade761cee4db4fd8/records/<record-id>`. Other equivalent record-URL forms are accepted as well.

Displayed as a multi-select field in HTML pages.

eintrittsdatum.label: Eintrittsdatum
eintrittsdatum.description:
A calendar date consisting of year, month and day (or `null`/`None`)

The field value will be a string in the format `<YYYY>-<MM>-<DD>` (or `null`/`None`).

For example: `2000-02-29`.

For `POST`/`PUT`/`PATCH` requests the REST API uses a liberal parsing approach so that strings like `2026`, `February 29, 2000 12:34 MEST`, `letztes Jahr` etc. will be accepted as value date values. However this runs the risk of parsing ambiguous values incorrectly. To ensure reliable parsing it is best to use the canonical format specified above.
